_contract: video-engine MCP -> create_flow_batch. DAY 1 = the four host transitions only; hooks are batch-hooks.json for day 2. The driver now SETS mode/submode/model/count and READS BACK the credits line before every submit; it refuses on Image mode, a wrong model, or a scene over maxCredits. Flow quoted 24 credits at x2/8s/720p on Omni 1.1 Flash, so x1/6s is the library setting and ~4 clips is a day.
_style: woodblock-vox-newsprint-v2 for the WHOLE frame, host included: he is a detailed illustrated figure in the scene's own register, never 'cartoon', never a silhouette, never a sticker. NO text, lettering, numerals, charts, graphs, axes or screens anywhere in frame - a chart in a generated frame is a fabricated figure.
